_comment.description: Sentinelas anomaly alert routing: Telegram + Gmail + Slack.
_comment.flow: Webhook -> Format/Enrich -> IF above_threshold -> Telegram(retry x3) -> Gmail(OAuth2) -> Slack(retry x3) -> Respond
credentials_required: Gmail node    -> gmailOAuth2Api credential (already auto-assigned in cloud).
Slack node    -> slackOAuth2Api credential; the bot must be IN the target channel.
important: The threshold decision is made INSIDE the Code node (above_threshold), not by the IF node's numeric operator. n8n 2.x evaluated '=0.95 >= 0.6' as FALSE with operator {type:number, operation:largerEqual}. The gate therefore uses {type:boolean, operation:true} on the precomputed boolean, which works.
Editing a published workflow only changes the DRAFT - you must Publish again for the webhook to run the new version.
Telegram's node returns {ok, result:{message_id}}, so delivery status must read result.message_id, not message_id at the top level.
